```{r load.data}
folder = "/sc/arion/projects/psychAD/NPS-AD/public_release_0/" 
file = paste0(folder, "PsychAD_r0_Dec_28_2022.h5ad")
sce = readH5AD(file, use_hdf5=TRUE, verbose=TRUE, version="0.8.0")
assayNames(sce)[1] = "counts"
sce$Dx = factor(sce$Dx_AD, c('Control','AD'))

# cell type order
ctorder = c('EN_L2_3_IT', 'EN_L3_5_IT_1', 'EN_L3_5_IT_2', 'EN_L3_5_IT_3', 'EN_L5_6_NP', 'EN_L6_CT', 'EN_L6_IT', 'EN_NF', 'IN_ADARB2', 'IN_LAMP5', 'IN_PVALB', 'IN_PVALB_CHC', 'IN_SST', 'IN_VIP', 'Oligo', 'OPC', 'Astro', 'Micro_PVM', 'CD8_T', 'PC', 'VLMC','Endo')

# harmony covariates
df = reducedDim(sce, "X_pca_regressed_harmony")
colnames(df) = paste0("hcomp_", seq(ncol(df)), sep="")
colData(sce) = cbind(colData(sce), df[,1:5])
```


```{r combineData, message=TRUE} 
# Create pseudo-bulk SingleCellExperiment
pb = aggregateToPseudoBulk(sce,
    assay = "counts", 
    cluster_id = "subclass",
    sample_id = "Channel")
```

```{r combineData2, message=TRUE} 
# Create pseudo-bulk SingleCellExperiment
pb2 = aggregateToPseudoBulk(sce,
    assay = "counts", 
    cluster_id = "subclass",
    sample_id = "SubID")
```

# Batch correction with Harmony

## Process data: log2 CPM + voom precision weights
```{r voom}
# poolID:
# Normalize and apply voom
form = ~ (1|SubID) + (1|poolID) + (1|Sex) + scale(Age) + (1|Dx) 
 
res.proc = processAssays( pb, form,
                          min.cells = 5,
                          min.counts = 10,
                          BPPARAM = SnowParam(12),
                          assays="Astro")

# Harmony:
# Normalize and apply voom
form = ~ (1|SubID) + (1|Sex) + scale(Age) + (1|Dx) + hcomp_1 + hcomp_2 + hcomp_3 + hcomp_4 + hcomp_5
 
res.proch = processAssays( pb, form,
                          min.cells = 5,
                          min.counts = 10,
                          BPPARAM = SnowParam(12),
                          assays="Astro")
```

```{r voom.plot, fig.height=15, fig.width=10, cache=TRUE} 
plotVoom( res.proc, ncol=4, assays=ctorder ) + theme_classic()  
plotVoom( res.proch, ncol=4, assays=ctorder ) + theme_classic()
```


## Variance Partitioning Analysis
```{r varPart}
# poolID
form = ~ (1|SubID) + (1|poolID) + (1|Sex) + scale(Age) + (1|Dx) 
 res.vp = fitVarPart(res.proc, form, BPPARAM = SnowParam(6))

# Harmony
form = ~ (1|SubID) + (1|Sex) + scale(Age) + (1|Dx) + hcomp_1 + hcomp_2 + hcomp_3 + hcomp_4 + hcomp_5
res.vph = fitVarPart(res.proch, form, BPPARAM = SnowParam(6))
```


```{r vp.plot, fig.height=15, fig.width=10}
# poolID
colnames(res.vp)[colnames(res.vp) == "scale.Age."] = 'Age'
colnames(res.vp)[colnames(res.vp) == "poolID"] = 'poolID'
colnames(res.vp)[colnames(res.vp) == "SubID"] = 'Subject'
col.vp = c(brewer.pal(ncol(res.vp)-3, "Set1"), "grey85")
names(col.vp) = colnames(sortCols(res.vp))[-seq(2)]

plotVarPart( sortCols(res.vp), label.angle=45, ncol=4, assays=ctorder, col=col.vp )

# Harmony
colnames(res.vph)[colnames(res.vph) == "scale.Age."] = 'Age'
colnames(res.vph)[colnames(res.vph) == "SubID"] = 'Subject'

plotVarPart( sortCols(res.vph), label.angle=45, ncol=4, assays=ctorder, col=col.vp )
```

### How well does Harmony capture Pool effect?


## Differential expression: dreamlet analysis
```{r dreamlet}
# poolID
form = ~ (1|SubID) + (1|poolID) + (1|Sex) + scale(Age) + Dx
fit = dreamlet( res.proc, form, BPPARAM = SnowParam(6))

# Harmony
form = ~ (1|SubID) + (1|Sex) + scale(Age) + Dx + hcomp_1 + hcomp_2 + hcomp_3 + hcomp_4 + hcomp_5
fith = dreamlet( res.proch form, BPPARAM = SnowParam(6))

# No Batch correction
form = ~ (1|SubID) + (1|Sex) + scale(Age) + Dx 
fit0 = dreamlet( res.proch form, BPPARAM = SnowParam(6))
```


# Limma
```{r limma}
form = ~ Sex + Age + Dx 

tab.limma = lapply(assayNames(pb2), function(id){

  design = model.matrix(form, colData(pb2))
  counts = assay(pb2, id)
  isexpr = filterByExpr(counts)
  dge = DGEList(counts[isexpr,])
  dge = calcNormFactors(dge)
  vobj = voom(dge, design)
  fit = lmFit(vobj, design)
  tab = topTable(fit, coef="DxAD", number=Inf)
  data.frame(CellType = id, tab)
  })
tab.limma = do.call(rbind, tab.limma)
```


# DESeq2
```{r DESeq2}
form = ~ Sex + Age + Dx 

tab.deseq2 = lapply(assayNames(pb2), function(id){

  counts = assay(pb2, id)
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(counts, colData(pb2), form)
  dds <- DESeq(dds)
  res <- results(dds)
  data.frame(CellType = id, res)
  })
tab.deseq2 = do.call(rbind, tab.deseq2)
```
